Name: Zosa and Bonster's Recipes
Author: rjgilber
Description:
For your consuming needs, here is a collection of 20 vanilla-compatible recipes (and one new ingredient).  All of these recipes are 100% lore-friendly and add a bit of variety for people who eat for immersion (these recipes are not balanced and one recipe is entirely for cheesing the game at the start of year three for people who need to catch up).
 
Things to know;
All recipes can be purchased in years 1-3.

Descriptions for the update will be coming soon!
